title: 映照
standfirst: 山与石形在水里倒置，岸上的树与楼向下延伸。到了近处，涟漪让两道轮廓分开。
standfirstEn: Mountains and rocks invert in water; trees and towers extend downwards. Nearby, ripples separate two outlines.
introduction: 山的亮面在水中再次出现，石形与树冠沿水线向下伸展。同一个地方因此有了两个方向：一个保持重量，另一个随着细波变动。
五幅照片由完整的山影走向岸边与湿沙，最后停在一条被折开的颈线。水保留了颜色和位置，却没有让上方的形状原样停住。
introductionEn: Bright mountain faces reappear in water; rocks and tree canopies extend down from the bank. One place acquires two directions: one keeps its weight while the other changes with fine ripples.
Five photographs move from mountain reflections towards banks and wet sand, ending with a broken line of a neck. Water retains colour and position while altering the forms above it.

chapters.title: 沿岸
chapters.text: 树列的橙色与楼体的灰色，各自延伸到水面以下。波纹把直线放松，较远的景物来到脚边。
chapters.textEn: Orange trees and grey towers extend beneath the waterline. Ripples loosen straight lines, bringing farther forms towards the feet.

chapters.title: 涟漪
chapters.text: 曲颈保持一道完整弧线，倒影却不断折转。水上的身体与水中的形状，在最后一幅里分开。
chapters.textEn: The neck keeps a continuous curve while its reflection turns repeatedly. Body and reflected form separate in the final photograph.
